# Transform

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/logic/components/`](../folders/src-logic-components.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/components/transform.h`](../../../src/logic/components/transform.h)

## Summary

Position, rotation and scale of an entity in world space.

## Description

World-space pose (Y up, -Z forward) of an entity; matrix() returns T * R * S. Required next to RigidBody (PhysicsSys / PhysicsStepSys write it for dynamic bodies, read it for kinematic ones) and ModelRenderable / ModelRef. Created from scene JSON (`Transform` key, registered in src/scene/system_registry.cpp), by BoxDropSys::init, and by host-side view systems (BoxRing, BoxThrower, VRControl hands, WorldView proxies, spawn helpers). resetSphereEpisode writes it on respawn.

## Scene JSON

"Transform": { "position": [x, y, z], "rotation": [x, y, z, w], "scale": [x, y, z] } (all optional; unknown keys rejected)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `position` | `glm::vec3` | (0, 0, 0) | world units / metres |
| `rotation` | `glm::quat` | identity (w=1) | JSON order [x, y, z, w] |
| `scale` | `glm::vec3` | (1, 1, 1) | applied last in matrix(); RigidBody::half_extent already includes it |
